ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity distribution with approximately 85% white surface area and 15% black perimeter and central notch mapping.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on both lobes; continuous black perimeter banding along the trailing edges; concentrated black pixel cluster at the median notch vertex extending toward the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; notable jagged peak-and-valley variations in pixel amplitude on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature of the trailing edges tapering into sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed textured clusters of high-contrast white and brown pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned dark grey linear scratches on the left lobe; a distinct set of 3-4 parallel reddish-brown rake marks on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel rake marks with reddish-brown pigmentation on the right lobe; prominent barnacle clusters on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique reddish-brown coloration within the rake mark abrasions on the right lobe surface.
